question: Should this PR be rebased and narrowed to the mobile-pairing follow-up before merge, or should maintainers intentionally sponsor the broad stale dependency/security/release surface shown in the current PR diff?
rationale: The central code fix is narrow, but the live PR carries protected labels, dependency-guard comments, and stale already-main files that automation should not waive without maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase and prove the narrow fix
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main so only the mobile-pairing delta remains, then require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the broad surface
options.body: Treat the dependency, release, and security-sensitive files as intentionally in scope and route the PR through the required owners before merge.

options.title: Replace with a clean PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if rebase cannot produce a reviewable mobile-only patch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main so only the mobile-pairing delta remains, then require real behavior proof before merge.
